parameters.formDescription: Generate a custom sales performance report

options.formSubmittedText: Your report is being generated. You will receive it shortly.

assignments.name: sections
assignments.value: ["Executive Summary", "KPI Dashboard", "Rep Performance", "Pipeline Analysis", "Win/Loss Analysis", "Forecast", "AI Insights"]

options.systemMessage: You are a sales analytics expert providing strategic insights to sales leadership. Be specific, actionable, and data-driven. Highlight both successes and areas for improvement.

parameters.jsCode:
// Generate HTML report const data = $input.first().json; // Parse AI insights let insights = { executiveSummary: 'Performance data analyzed for the reporting period.', keyWins: ['Data collection complete'], concerns: ['Review metrics for details'], recommendations: ['Continue monitoring KPIs'], nextPeriodFocus: ['Maintain momentum'] }; try { const aiOutput = data.output || data.text || ''; const jsonMatch = aiOutput.match(/```json\n?([\s\S]*?)\n?```/) || aiOutput.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (jsonMatch) { insights = { ...insights, ...JSON.parse(jsonMatch[1] || jsonMatch[0]) }; } } catch (e) { console.log('Using default insights'); } const html = `

Sales Performance Report

${data.reportConfig.reportType} Report: ${data.reportConfig.startDate} to ${data.reportConfig.endDate}

Executive Summary

${insights.executiveSummary}

Key Performance Indicators

${data.kpis.revenue.formatted}
Revenue
${data.kpis.revenue.growth} vs prev
${data.kpis.winRate.formatted}
Win Rate
${data.kpis.winRate.won}W / ${data.kpis.winRate.lost}L
${data.kpis.avgDealSize.formatted}
Avg Deal Size
${data.kpis.salesCycle.formatted}
Sales Cycle
${data.kpis.pipeline.formatted}
Pipeline Value
${data.kpis.pipeline.count} deals
${data.kpis.pipeline.coverage}
Pipeline Coverage
${data.kpis.quota.percentage}
Quota Attainment
${data.kpis.quota.achieved} / ${data.kpis.quota.target}
${data.kpis.leads.conversionRate}
Lead Conversion
${data.kpis.leads.converted} / ${data.kpis.leads.new}

Rep Performance

${data.repPerformance.map(r => ` `).join('')}
Sales Rep Quota Achieved Attainment Win Rate Pipeline Status
${r.rep} ${r.quotaFormatted} ${r.achievedFormatted} ${r.quotaAttainment} ${r.winRate} ${r.pipelineValue} ${r.status}

Pipeline Analysis

${data.pipelineAnalysis.byStage.map(s => ` `).join('')}
Stage Deals Value Weighted Avg Days in Stage
${s.stage} ${s.count} ${s.value} ${s.weighted} ${s.avgDaysInStage} days

AI Insights & Recommendations

✅ Key Wins

    ${insights.keyWins.map(w => `
  • ${w}
    • `).join('')}

⚠️ Areas of Concern

    ${insights.concerns.map(c => `
  • ${c}
    • `).join('')}

📋 Recommendations

    ${insights.recommendations.map(r => `
  • ${r}
    • `).join('')}

🎯 Focus for Next Period

    ${insights.nextPeriodFocus.map(f => `
  • ${f}
    • `).join('')}
Report generated on ${new Date().toLocaleString()} | Powered by n8n Sales Automation
`; return { json: { ...data, insights, reportHtml: html, reportSubject: `Sales ${data.reportConfig.reportType} Report: ${data.reportConfig.startDate} to ${data.reportConfig.endDate}` } };
